device.name: Unitree G1 AMP locomotion in Isaac Lab (legged_lab)

facts.text: The repository is an extension for legged-robot reinforcement learning based on Isaac Lab
The README badge lists Isaac Sim 5.1.0 and Isaac Lab 2.3.2
Isaac Lab v2.3.2 must be installed before this package
Git LFS is required, and git lfs install followed by git lfs pull downloads the USD models and motion data
The package is installed with python -m pip install -e source/legged_lab
Training uses a customized rsl_rl cloned from the feature/amp branch
The extension declares isaaclab, isaaclab_assets, isaaclab_mimic, isaaclab_rl and isaaclab_tasks as dependencies
LeggedLab-Isaac-AMP-G1-v0 is registered with gymnasium.register and its entry point is legged_lab.envs:ManagerBasedAmpEnv
LeggedLab-Isaac-AMP-G1-Play-v0 is registered with the same entry point and the play configuration
ManagerBasedAmpEnv subclasses ManagerBasedAnimationEnv
ManagerBasedAnimationEnv subclasses Isaac Lab's ManagerBasedRLEnv, imported from isaaclab.envs
ManagerBasedAmpEnv.load_managers builds the managers and then calls self._configure_gym_env_spaces()
ManagerBasedAmpEnv.step takes an action of shape (num_envs, action_dim) and returns observations, rewards, terminated, truncated and extras
The action term is a JointPositionAction over every joint (joint_names ['.*']) with scale 0.25 and use_default_offset=True
The policy observation group concatenates base_ang_vel, root_local_rot_tan_norm, velocity_commands, joint_pos, joint_vel and actions, with history_length 5, corruption enabled and terms concatenated
root_local_rot_tan_norm returns the tangent and normal vectors of the local rotation matrix, six values in total
The decimation is 4, the episode length is 20.0 s and the simulation timestep is 0.005 s
The termination terms are a time-out, an illegal contact, a base height below 0.2 m and a bad orientation above 60 degrees
G1AmpEnvCfg disables the base_contact termination
G1AmpEnvCfg replaces the scene robot with UNITREE_G1_29DOF_CFG
The G1 asset lists 29 joint_sdk_names, from left_hip_pitch_joint to right_wrist_yaw_joint

The G1 initial joint positions set the hip pitch to -0.1, the knee to 0.3, the ankle pitch to -0.2, the shoulder pitch to 0.3, the shoulder roll to +-0.25, the elbow to 0.97 and the wrist roll to +-0.15
The G1 AMP command ranges are -0.5 to 3.0 for lin_vel_x, -0.5 to 0.5 for lin_vel_y, -1.0 to 1.0 for ang_vel_z and -pi to pi for heading
The G1 AMP reset event samples the reference animation with a height offset of 0.1
The animation term enables random_initialize and random_fetch, so a reset draws a random reference motion

determinism.notes: the fake reseeds Python's random.Random from reset(seed), so one seed repeats the fake's own trajectory; Isaac Lab draws from numpy/torch generators and its seeding was not observed, so the same seed is not claimed to reproduce an Isaac Sim trajectory

gaps: the fake is a kinematic stand-in (F0): no rigid-body dynamics, contacts, friction, actuators, sensors, terrain, motion data or rendering; the joint positions are a direct mapping of the scaled action and were never compared with an Isaac Sim run

the action space is published as an unbounded 29-value Box because the clone configures a joint-position action over every joint and states no numeric action bound (amp_env_cfg.py:92); the 29-value joint count comes from the G1 asset's joint_sdk_names list (unitree.py:167-197), and the real total_action_dim and the Isaac Lab Box bounds were not observed

the fake publishes only the 29 joint positions in a single observation group named policy, while the configured policy group concatenates base_ang_vel, root_local_rot_tan_norm, velocity_commands, joint_pos, joint_vel and actions with a five-step history (amp_env_cfg.py:113-129); the real flattened width is computed by Isaac Lab outside the clone and was not observed

only the 20.0 s time-out is modelled; the base_height below 0.2 m and bad_orientation above 60 degree terminations (amp_env_cfg.py:313-323) need physics and are not modelled, and base_contact is disabled for G1 (g1_amp_env_cfg.py:223)
the reward is a constant placeholder, not the sum of the configured reward terms, because those terms are external Isaac Lab MDP functions

the fake applies the action as a joint-position offset with scale 0.25 on top of the asset's configured default positions (amp_env_cfg.py:92, unitree.py:94-105); the joint order is assumed to follow joint_sdk_names and actuator dynamics and effort limits are not modelled

the upstream reset event reset_from_ref samples a reference motion (g1_amp_env_cfg.py:200, amp_env_cfg.py:359-361); the fake instead draws small joint offsets from Python's random.Random, so a seed does not reproduce an Isaac Sim episode
the sim backend (gymnasium.make('LeggedLab-Isaac-AMP-G1-v0')) was not run: it needs Isaac Sim 5.1.0, Isaac Lab 2.3.2, Git LFS assets, the forked rsl_rl and a GPU (README.md:3-4, :64, :83-89, :98-107)
the fake returns Python floats and lists rather than torch tensors on a GPU and has no wall-clock pacing: realtime_factor 0 and one tick advances simulated time by 20 ms only
snapshot and restore are not offered: the environment exposes no get_state/set_state pair in the clone

measures.description: Last observation (derived from the observation space)
measures.name: observation

safe_state.description: the simulation stops advancing: no step or reset is accepted after an e-stop until mhs.safety.reset clears the latch; the environment state is kept and stays readable
